# Maryland Association of Boards of Education (MABE)

> MABE represents all 24 Maryland school boards and provides advocacy, professional development, and governance support to advance public education.

MABE is the statewide organization serving Maryland's boards of education with legislative advocacy at state and federal levels, professional development programs, and resources for school governance. The organization coordinates with member boards across all Maryland counties and maintains active committees focused on educational equity, governance standards, and policy priorities.

## Key Topics

- Maryland education
- Board governance
- Legislative advocacy

- [Legislative Committee](https://www.mabe.org/advocacy/legislative-committee-2): MABE Legislative Committee guiding advocacy and lobbying
- [State Board Advocacy Center](https://www.mabe.org/advocacy/state-board-advocacy-center): MABE state board advocacy and regulatory monitoring
